messages:
Sophia: T-minus 90m for v3.4.0 rollout. Quick read: smoke passed in staging, canary scheduled in 30m. We need final sign-offs on pins, rollback commands checked, and freeze window confirm. Drop updates here. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Deploy Bot: Canary job queued by @Sophia. canary-id=canary-2024-03-21-30. Will post status when warmups done. :robot_face:
Omar: Infra smoke green. Load simulator ran 5m at expected qps, no OOMs. CPU steady ~60%.
Lina: I'm on routing and traffic-shift. Canary route will be 2% for 15m then 10% if metrics look good. Monitoring alerts wired.
Kevin: Pin checklist: dependency pin to model v3.4.0-rc2 ✅, runtime image pinned to rwinf-6.2.3 ✅. Release notes pushed: https://internal.redwood/release/v3.4.0
Sophia: Ana, product sign-off for release notes/marketing blurb?
Ana (Product): Quick read done. Approved for launch. Small note: update docs section about streaming behavior. I can ship a docs patch post-merge. :thumbsup:
Deploy Bot: Canary started — canary-2024-03-21-30: status=warming. Logs: `init -> kvcache load -> kernel selection -> ready`
Omar: Oncall smoke: real request path smoke test passed (edge -> canary). No 5xx in last 50 requests.
Kevin: Rollback commands validated. Copy below (tested in staged):
```
# rollback to v3.3.9
deploy rollback --service inference --to-version v3.3.9 --force --reason "canary failure"
# drain canary nodes
infra drain --tag canary-2024-03-21-30
```
Lina: Freeze window: current freeze starts now until +3h after full rollout. If we need emergency hotfix, call for an exemption here and tag @Sophia.
Sophia: Quick safety checks: 1) Monitoring alerts + dashboards open? 2) Can we pause traffic shift manually? 3) Rollback runbook accessible? Reply yes/no.
Omar: 1) yes dashboards up, 2) yes traffic shift pause is manual toggle in console, 3) runbook link posted in #eng-oncall earlier — I can paste if needed.
Kevin: yes/yes/yes
Lina: yes, and I've pre-set the manual hold for the 2%->10% step.
Ana (Product): yes on notes and rollback comms.
Sophia: All right. Final go/no-go votes. Reply with "GO" or "NO GO". We need majority GO.
Omar: GO
Lina: GO
Kevin: GO
Ana (Product): GO
Deploy Bot: Canary progressed: health=ok, p50 latency ~40ms, error-rate 0.2% (< threshold).
Oncall Bot: Alert policy check: no critical alerts firing. Recent flapping detected but under threshold.
Sophia: Marking GO. Initiating 2% canary -> monitor for 15m -> escalate if >0.5% errors or latency >150ms.
Lina: Kicking off traffic shift. Will post updates at 5m intervals or on anomalies.
Deploy Bot: Traffic shift: 2% -> started. canary-2024-03-21-30 route:update ok
Omar: Note: I've got rollback command ready in pinned message. If we hit threshold within first 5m, I will run `deploy rollback` and notify channel.
Sophia: If anyone sees anything odd, ping @oncall and @Sophia immediately. Keeping the freeze in place until +3h post-rollout. :lock:
Lina: 5m checkpoint: no errors spike, metrics stable.
Kevin: Noted. I'll watch cost and token spend during canary spike.
Deploy Bot: Canary update: 10m passed, health=ok, error-rate steady at 0.15%.
Sophia: Thanks team. Continuing monitor. If all good at 15m we'll scale to 10% then complete rollout per playbook.
Lina: A small ask — if docs patch isn't ready by finish, we'll tag the release with a docs follow-up. Proceeding anyway.
Ana (Product): Agreed. Docs follow-up ok.
Sophia: Closing thread for noise. Will post final rollout completion or rollback notice here. :white_check_mark:
